info.title: PekanGame Reseller API
info.description: Order placement, order status, price list, and wallet balance for a PekanGame reseller account. Every request needs a Bearer API key issued by PekanGame — Authorization: Bearer <key>.

get.description: The calling reseller's current prepaid wallet balance, in sen.

examples.message: An API key is required. Send it as a bearer token.
This reseller account is deactivated.
Too many requests. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After header.

get.description: Every orderable product for the calling reseller, grouped by game. Each package's `price_sen` is your own price for that package, in sen. Order against `packages[].code` (`{game code}-{denomination}`).

examples.message: An API key is required. Send it as a bearer token.
This reseller account is deactivated.

422.description: `NO_TIER_ASSIGNED` — this account has no pricing configured yet.

examples.message: This reseller account has no pricing configured yet. Contact PekanGame to set it up.
Too many requests. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After header.

get.description: The caller's own orders, newest first, cursor-paginated. Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response back as `?cursor=` for the next page (`null` = no more). `?limit=` is capped at 100 (default 25); optional `?status=` filters on delivery status and `?created_after=` (ISO 8601) on creation time. A cursor, not a page number, so a new order landing mid-pagination never shifts the window.

examples.message: The request payload failed validation.
An API key is required. Send it as a bearer token.
This reseller account is deactivated.
Too many requests. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After header.

post.description: Charges your wallet and submits the order for fulfilment. Send a fresh `idempotency_key` (UUID) per logical order: a replay with the **same** key and payload returns the original order with HTTP 200 and an `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header; the **same** key with a different payload is a 409 conflict.

200.description: Idempotent replay — the original order (also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

examples.message: Wallet balance is insufficient for this order.
An API key is required. Send it as a bearer token.
This reseller account is deactivated.

409.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT` — the key was reused with a different payload.

examples.message: This idempotency_key was already used for an order with a different payload. Use a fresh key per logical order.
Too many requests. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After header.

get.description: The current status of one of the caller's own orders. Poll this as the fallback to the delivery webhook.

examples.message: An API key is required. Send it as a bearer token.
This reseller account is deactivated.

404.description: `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` — no order with that number belongs to the caller.

examples.message: No order was found for that order number.
Too many requests. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After header.
